These are excerpts of real runs, not complete runs (server paths inside are fine, no personal paths).

- `x100/`: the 100-agent Covertype run (61 min). Events: all but 12 reviews and 10 refusals kept; ledger: all lifecycle and the 8 submits, first 100 commits; long text fields clipped to 300 characters. `monitor/` is the old nested machine format (readings from minute 29), next to `runs/` as the monitor wrote it.
- `x3/`: the 3-agent Covertype run on the server, same kind of excerpt.
- `synthetic/`: a complete synthetic run (8 agents, 8 slots) with the new flat `machine.jsonl` and `run-facts.json`.
